title: Weather by work address
description: The crew sees the intervals it needs and how conditions change at its sites.

blocks.text: Different jobs depend on different conditions. One shared temperature does not help coordinate the schedule across several sites.

quote.text: I have used this app for years as a premium/paid user because I work outside and need the alerts if lightning or adverse weather is coming. The alerts have stopped working.

blocks.text: Save the addresses, the periods and the parameters that matter to the team. Show what changed and pass one agreed overview to everyone involved.
The rules for stopping work are set separately; the app should not declare conditions safe on its own.
